liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **El Paso** (4 reviews): Reviewer especially enjoyed the acoustic El Paso; Acoustic El Paso is a treat, worth downloading even for completists of full shows [6][7][8][9]
- **Heaven Help the Fool** (1 review): Heaven Help the Fool is played as an instrumental, as at the Warfield and Radio City shows of 1980 [10]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer calls Bird Song unreal [15]
- **The Race Is On** (1 review): The Race Is On features jamming, per this reviewer [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-10-13s1t01 banter-Bob's Anniversary**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t02 On The Road Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t03 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t04 El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t05 To Lay Me Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t06 Heaven Help The Fool**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t07 Jack-a-roe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **gd80-10-13s1t08 The Race Is On**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-13.137297.sbd.bershaw-composite.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 201 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd80-10-13.acoustic-sbd.munder.13064.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 46 min; rated 4.71/5 by 14 [5]. Said about its sound: Exceptional soundboard of the acoustic run; Jerry's guitar comes through very clearly in the right channel; Crystal clear sound throughout, though a few technical glitches are present; Soundboard recording is about as good as it gets [6][8][10][15]
- **gd1980-10-13.114417.aud.vman.flac16**: audience recording; 32 songs; 201 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1980-10-13.137256.sbd.clugston.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 129 min [3]

## Around the show

- Band was tight tonight, with solid vocals, strong riffs, and solos flowing naturally in and out of the music [11]
- Attendee saw six shows that month; this one stood out for the band's tightness and rapport with the crowd [17]
- Attendee felt it resembled Jerry and Merle in a small room; recalls Etta James joining in on some night of the series [17]
- Reviewer suggests this may be the best of the 1980 acoustic sets [9]
- Some Warfield acoustic sets sound better than others; this is one of the better ones [11]
- Reviewer ranks this possibly the best of the Warfield and Radio City acoustic sets [16]
- Connection with the audience was remarkable even compared with the other acoustic shows at the Warfield [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-13.137297.sbd.bershaw-composite.flac16**: source: sbd composite upgrade by Alan Bershaw; see info file for details [1]. Also: Uploader built a composite, since this show only circulated in fragments and no complete set from the night ever circulated [1]
- **gd80-10-13.acoustic-sbd.munder.13064.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
- **gd1980-10-13.114417.aud.vman.flac16**: source: source: unknown audience recording > cassette x2 > CDR (using Nakamichi BX300 playback > H/K CDR2 (stand alone CD recorder); [2]
- **gd1980-10-13.137256.sbd.clugston.sbeok.flac16**: source: Recording Info: 1st Electric Set & 2nd Electric Set partial (thru The Other One) SBD > many cassette generations > Cass; Transfer Info: Cassette played back on… [3]
